subject: Provincial Emergency Financial Assistance Order No. 300, British Columbia
precis: Provincial Emergency Financial Assistance Order No. 300 in order to (1) declare the natural disaster to be of concern to the federal government; and (2) authorize the provision of financial assistance to British Columbia with respect to the interface fires that occurred in British Columbia, from August to September 2025.
